citation.authors: Abubakar SM, Ukeyima MT, Spencer JPE, Lovegrove JA
citation.title: Acute Effects of Hibiscus sabdariffa Calyces on Postprandial Blood Pressure, Vascular Function, Blood Lipids, Biomarkers of Insulin Resistance and Inflammation in Humans

population.description: Men with 1 to 10% 10-year CVD risk (QRISK2), not taking BP medication, no kidney, liver or chronic disease (Methods 2.4); 25 recruited, 22 in Tables 3 to 5 ('mean ± SEM of 22 volunteers'). Age and BMI: Table 2 water visit, mean ± SEM printed; sd computed by the reader as SEM x sqrt(22) (age 2.0 x 4.69 = 9.38; BMI 0.7 x 4.69 = 3.28). Table 2 prints no n of its own, so no Table 2 value is entered as a finding; the 22 of Tables 3 to 5 is used only to shape the virtual cohort. Status unselected: screening was a health questionnaire and fasting blood tests (glucose, lipids), with no glucose-tolerance test and no healthy label in the paper.

protocols.name: water_visit
protocols.description: Water visit of the crossover (Methods 2.2, 2.7, 2.10). Fasted, water only, for the past 12 h at arrival (stated). 30 min rest in bed before BP measurement (stated); arm minute = paper minute + 30 (arm 0-29 is the rest). The paper does not say how long the baseline BP readings, cannula and baseline blood take between the end of the rest and breakfast, so the breakfast at arm minute 30 is a placement, not a printed time. Breakfast at paper 0 (arm 30): 120 g buttered croissants, 30 g butter, 15 g honey, with 250 mL water (water is nothing). Lunch at paper 120 min (arm 150): 89 g bread, 33 g soft cheese, 35 g shortbread, 18 g crisps, with water. Grams from Table 1 as printed: breakfast carbohydrate 70.2, fat 50.1 (saturated 32.3), protein 8.6; lunch carbohydrate 70.1, fat 24.9 (saturated 11.4), protein 12.8. BP and heart rate at paper 0, 60, 120, 180, 240 min (arm 30, 90, 150, 210, 270; Methods 2.7); blood at paper 0 to 240 min, minutes not printed. Posture at the readings is not stated beyond the rest in bed.

meals.food: bread, soft cheese, shortbread and crisps
